mission: Reconcile import paths between ALPHA and EPSILON teams; wire bus compaction into multi-team runner

changes.description: Fixed PartitionManager -> PartitionedStore in status messages (lines 837, 840) to match DELTA's actual class name in db_partition.py. Rate limiter import path was already correct (prototype.agent_comm.rate_limiter.RateLimiter). Bus compaction import was already correct (prototype.agent_comm.compactor.BusCompactor).
issues_fixed: EPSILON referenced 'PartitionManager' in status messages but DELTA named the class 'PartitionedStore'

changes.description: Replaced fallback import chain (prototype.agent_comm.state, storage.coordination.rate_limiter) with direct import from prototype.agent_comm.rate_limiter. Rewrote benchmark_rate_limiter() to use the real RateLimiter(db_path) constructor with .configure() and .check_and_reserve() API instead of the nonexistent RateLimiter(max_requests=, window_seconds=) constructor with .check() method.
issues_fixed: Wrong import paths: tried prototype.agent_comm.state and storage.coordination.rate_limiter before correct path
Constructor mismatch: used RateLimiter(max_requests=1000, window_seconds=60) but actual is RateLimiter(db_path)
Method mismatch: called rl.check(agent_id) but actual API is rl.check_and_reserve(endpoint, agent_id)

changes.description: Wired BusCompactor from prototype.agent_comm.compactor into the multi-team runner. Added: (1) optional import with _HAS_COMPACTOR flag, (2) compactor/offset store initialization in init_environment(), (3) periodic compaction thread with configurable interval (default disabled), (4) final compaction in stop() shutdown sequence, (5) --compaction-interval CLI argument, (6) config JSON support for compaction_interval key.
issues_fixed: Bus compaction was not integrated into the multi-team runner shutdown sequence
